{{Quote|The Chief Virologist is....well, was...Dr. Giffax Jin.|[[Klex Fulgor]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Administrative Access|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Griffax Jin''' was a [[Biologist/Legends|virologist]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I've been sent by Vader to collect the sample.''"<br />"''It is too dangerous. So many lives lost...only to come back. I'm (Cough) not going to let you have it! Oh no....noooo....Ack!|A spacer and Dr. Griffax Jin, right before the latter became an undead|<ref name="SWG:WN" />}}
[[File:UndeadGriffaxJin.jpg|thumb|left|120px|The undead incarnation of Griffax Jin.]]
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jin conducted operations as part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Scientist/Legends|science]] staff in the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. There, scientists were secretly conducting dangerous scientific research for the Empire, intending to re-engineer the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] into a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]]. Dr. Jin operated in the cryogenics [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] of the on level 2 of the research center and served as the chief virologist.<ref name="SWG:RFL1" />
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Griffax Jin was present when an accident took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility and the virus [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|escaped]] containment. The virus killed most of the people in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|area]], turning them into [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. Dr. Jin survived the outbreak but was infected by the virus. A group of spacers later found Griffax Jin in his lab during their search for an original sample if the virus. They interrogated Jin but the scientist was not eager to help them, considering that the virus should be destroyed, along with the research facility. However, Griffax Jin finally turned into a zombie and attacked the spacer who were forced to defend themselves, killing the undead scientist. The spacer eventually found the virus they were looking for in Dr. Jin's lab.<ref name="SWG:WN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Griffax Jin appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RFL1" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Griffax Jin was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
